Changes.note: Enrolling or applying creates your enrollment in this course. Where the course, its köşk, its medrese or the platform requires approval, it waits as a request: the course team sees it, approves or rejects it, and you are told. Otherwise you hold a seat at once and the course's sessions come to your calendar. You can withdraw a waiting request without being asked, and leave a seat after confirming: either way your enrollment and your progress are deleted, the sessions leave your calendar, and you may apply again. A completed course cannot be left. If the course team takes you out, only the team can give the seat back. While a ban stands, applying, withdrawing and leaving are refused.
CoursePage.actionConflict: Your enrollment has changed. The page was refreshed, so check its current state.
CoursePage.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
CoursePage.actionNotFound: This course can no longer be found.
CoursePage.applyNote: You get a notification once it is approved.
CoursePage.approvalNotice: Enrollment needs approval: the course team reviews your application.
CoursePage.completedNote: The course team confirmed it on {date}. While the course runs you keep access to its sessions and recordings.
CoursePage.leaveBody: You are about to leave {title}. You lose access to its sessions, meeting links, recordings and deck, and its sessions drop out of your calendar.
CoursePage.leaveBodyCards: The cards you copied into your own decks stay with you. You can apply to the course again.
CoursePage.openEnrollNotice: Enrollment needs no approval: the course contents open to you once you enroll.
CoursePage.pendingSubmitted: Your application reached the course team {when}. You get a notification once it is approved.
CoursePage.receivedBody: The course staff will review your application. You will get a notification once it is approved; the lessons, session meeting links and recordings open to you then.
CoursePage.receivedNote: Until it is approved you can withdraw your application from this page.
CoursePage.revokedBody: You can no longer reach the sessions, meeting links, recordings open only to enrolled students, or the course deck; the course's sessions have also left your calendar. You can still see the introduction, the titles of the curriculum and the publicly available recordings.
CoursePage.revokedTitle: Your access to this course was withdrawn.
